name: – Joachim Streit – After § 19 – Am 5
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2025
part_text: 19a. Rules out the use of EIB resources for the funding and promotion of militarisation; takes the view that these resources should be put towards meeting the economic and social needs of the people, in particular addressing the rising cost of living and helping uphold the right to decent, sustainable and affordable housing for all;
